draft.title: The promotion mix
card: Promotion is how a business tells customers about its product and persuades them to buy. The promotion mix is the set of methods it combines to do this.
Advertising
paid messages in media such as TV, radio, print or online. It reaches many people at once, but the business pays for the space.
Personal selling
face to face or phone contact between a salesperson and a customer. It suits products that need explaining, and it reaches fewer people at a higher cost per person.
Other methods
sales promotions are short-term offers such as discounts, free samples and coupons. Public relations is unpaid coverage, such as media stories. Social media builds contact through posts and comments.
draft.remember: No single method does everything, so businesses combine several to reach customers.

a.q: Which of these is an example of a sales promotion?
opts: A cafe gives a free coffee with each lunch bought this week
A cafe pays for a radio spot about its new menu
A cafe owner chats to diners about the menu at their tables
A cafe's story about a local charity appears in the news
a.why: A free coffee for a short time is a short-term offer that pushes customers to buy now, which is a sales promotion. The radio spot is tempting, but it is advertising because the business pays for a message in the media.
a.clue: Look for a short-term offer that pushes people to buy now.

b.q: Lena sells solar panel systems in Bathurst. Each system is costly and needs explaining to the buyer. Which method best suits this need?
opts: Personal selling, as a salesperson can explain each system
A one-week discount coupon, as it pushes buyers to act fast
A paid billboard, as it reaches many people in town
A social media post, as it is seen by followers
b.why: A costly product that needs explaining suits personal selling, where a salesperson can answer questions and tailor the advice. A billboard reaches many people, which is tempting, but it cannot explain a system to each buyer.
b.clue: Which method lets the business answer a buyer's questions directly?

a.best: A cafe gives a free coffee with each lunch bought this week

b.best: Personal selling, as a salesperson can explain each system

proposal.title: The promotion mix
card: Promotion is how a business tells customers about its product and persuades them to buy. Each method has strengths and limits, so the promotion mix is the set of methods a business combines.
Advertising
paid messages in media such as TV, radio, print or online. It reaches many people at once, but the business pays for the space.
Personal selling
face to face or phone contact between a salesperson and a customer. The salesperson can answer questions and tailor advice to each buyer, but it reaches fewer people at a higher cost per person.
Other methods

sales promotions are short-term offers such as discounts, free samples and coupons. Public relations builds a positive image and good relations with the public, through media stories, sponsorships and events. Social media builds two-way contact through posts and comments.
proposal.remember: No single method does everything, so businesses combine several to reach customers.

a.q: Which of these is an example of a sales promotion?
opts: A café gives a free coffee with each lunch bought this week
A café pays for a radio spot about its new menu
A café owner chats to diners about the menu at their tables

a.why: A free coffee for a short time is a short-term offer that pushes customers to buy now, which is a sales promotion. The radio spot is tempting, but it is advertising because the business pays for a message in the media.
a.clue: Look for a short-term offer that pushes people to buy now.

b.q: Lena sells solar panel systems in Bathurst. Each system costs thousands of dollars, and buyers want to know which one suits their roof and power use. Which method best fits?
opts: Personal selling, as advice is tailored to each buyer
A one-week coupon, as it pushes buyers to act fast
A paid billboard, as it reaches many people in town
A social media post, as it is seen by many followers
b.why: Buyers need advice that fits their own home, and personal selling lets a salesperson answer questions and tailor advice to each buyer. A billboard is tempting because it reaches many people, but it gives everyone the same message and cannot advise each buyer.
b.clue: Which method lets the business talk with one buyer about their own home?

a.best: A café gives a free coffee with each lunch bought this week

b.best: Personal selling, as advice is tailored to each buyer
